title: Contact Deal Notes
description: Send a correction, a recall tip or a question about a Deal Notes buying guide.
intro: Spotted an error, a recalled product in one of our guides, or a broken link? Send it here. Corrections are the messages we act on fastest.

sections.h: What should I include in a correction?
sections.answer: The page address, what is wrong, and a link to a source that shows the correct information.

sections.h: Can you help with an Amazon order?
sections.answer: No. We are not Amazon and cannot see or change orders. For order problems, contact Amazon customer service directly.
